summary: Prudential plc furnished a routine Form 6-K containing a UK-style PDMR disclosure (equivalent to a US Form 4 insider transaction notice) regarding share acquisitions under the dividend re-investment feature of the Prudential All Employee Share Purchase Plan. CFO Ben Bulmer acquired 3 HKD shares at HKD 94.3457 and 53 GBP shares at GBP 9.064418 on 2026-10-29 on the Hong Kong and London exchanges; other PDMRs made similarly small acquisitions. No special-situation event, terms, board recommendation, or advisor is involved; purely administrative insider reporting with no deal implications.
